feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original exact BA9D0 HUD text renderer and its two canonical clip/sprani append sites plus R30 semantic consumer; excludes GOAL, +TIME, ESC, F11, main-menu, lens, DX11, DXVK, SkyGlow and input.
trace_stages: Canonical 0xBA9D0 C++ inline hook resolves exact calling RVA for OutRun HUD peripheral versus protected result/GOAL siblings.
Original immediate raster can draw before BA9D0's exact clip/sprani calls append SpriteNodes, therefore stale queue token cannot identify the direct glyph.
New bounded scoped exact owner advertises only the active direct token and restores nested state; queue-selected SpriteNode identity stays authoritative.
R30 finite binocular XYZRHW viewport/FOV/per-eye mapping uses active producer from direct or queue while protected compositing and desktop fallback remain unchanged.
subcomponents: Source-time direct glyph semantic and exact producer owner with scoped state restoration, narrow VR predicate and preserved original call.
Queued clip and sprani children retain prior append tags, explicit effective producer selects live queue token over direct token in replay.
Integrated source regression protects destructive mutations of direct/queue precedence, domain boundaries and full Win32 DX9Ex build.

Queue depth wins over direct source token, nested direct producers restore previous token, desktop game/GOAL/+TIME/world/F11/menu semantics remain unchanged.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Quest3 user HUD positioned too centrally and tiny at 3440x1440 desktop and 2496x2688 XR eye; OutRunHudTextProducer_dest emitted exact queue tokens but lacked a scoped token for synchronous glyph submission.
diagnosis.root_cause: The queue-only CurrentSpriteQueueProducer token could not identify direct glyph draw submissions before SpriteNode append; scoped screen ownership alone cannot trigger narrow responsive peripheral grouping.
alternatives_rejected: Do not infer edge alignment from arbitrary screen coordinates or promote GOAL/+TIME/world sprites to screen-peripheral.
Do not overwrite the queue producer globally because stale nodes and nested original draws require distinct authority.
source_trace: Original BA9D0 source-callsite classifier recognizes three peripheral ranges and excludes the GOAL/result source map.
Original clip and sprani wrappers register all deferred nodes with exact ScreenHud producer provenance.
Scoped direct source owner now carries producer identity only outside queue; R30 picks active producer before source XYZRHW per-eye placement.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Viewport, FOV containment, symmetric horizontal displacement and bilateral bounds protection remain in R30; new selector changes only exact source ownership for qualifying original glyph draws.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Source commit 257799c2 implements separate direct token RAII and queue-precedence selector. Current commit adds run contract and negative regression assertions.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing R30 numeric 4:3/16:9/21:9 plus Quest3 extent, negative producer mutation and new direct/queue/nesting-destructive source cases; exact workflows pending.
diagnosis.unresolved: Real Quest3/VDXR optical parity, legibility and game-frame pacing not established by source CI. Inspect matching build on HMD.
